description: ANY-631 regression set for the status of client terms in ProposalAI (the prompt's Terms section, rules 1-5). Each order names the rule it exercises. `must` / `must_not` are literal checks only: a value that has to appear and amounts that must not appear (a forbidden amount is a critical error). `criteria` are questions a human answers for every output; see qa_cases.json for the kinds.

orders.rule: 4: a client budget and deadline that conflict with the scope are stated as not accepted, no replacement value
orders.task_text: A bakery owner wants a new logo, a 20-page brand guide and social media templates within 3 days for USD 150. She expects unlimited logo concepts until she likes one. Her current brand photos will be ready in two weeks. Write a proposal that points out what conflicts, declines unlimited concepts and offers to discuss a smaller first step. Do not accept the deadline or suggest a different price.
orders.freelancer_positioning: I am a brand designer working in Illustrator and Figma. I have designed logos and short brand guides for local food businesses. I work with a fixed number of concept rounds agreed in advance.

criteria.question: Is USD 150 explicitly marked as the client's budget that is not agreed (proposed and not agreed, or refused)?
Is the 3-day deadline refused in so many words?
Are unlimited logo concepts refused in so many words?
Is none of the client's USD 150 budget, 3-day deadline or unlimited logo concepts stated as accepted, agreed or as the freelancer's own?

orders.rule: 2: every agreed term is restated exactly and confirmed, none is declined
orders.task_text: Клиент согласовал тексты для 12 карточек товаров интернет-магазина чая: по 600–800 знаков каждая, итого 36 000 ₽. Сдача всех текстов в Google Docs до 18:00 по Москве 20 ноября 2026. Включены два раунда правок в течение 3 рабочих дней после сдачи; новые карточки сверх 12 оплачиваются отдельно по 3 000 ₽. Фото и SEO-оптимизация не входят. Оплата 50% = 18 000 ₽ до начала, 18 000 ₽ после сдачи. Нужно подтверждение условий.
orders.freelancer_positioning: Пишу продающие тексты для интернет-магазинов, работаю по брифу и тону бренда клиента. Бриф с характеристиками товаров нужен до начала работы.

criteria.question: Are the agreed 36 000 ₽, the 20 November deadline, the 18 000 + 18 000 ₽ payments and 3 000 ₽ per extra card restated and confirmed, never called proposed or not agreed?
Is the brief with product details required before the work starts?

orders.rule: 1: the freelancer accepts a change to an agreed limit; it is stated as accepted and replaces the earlier term (code review #1 P1)
orders.task_text: The client and I agreed a landing page design in Figma with one revision round for USD 400, delivery on 20 November 2026. The client now asks for a second revision round. Accept the second round at no extra cost and confirm the other agreed terms.
orders.freelancer_positioning: I am a UI designer working in Figma. I design landing pages for small service businesses.

criteria.question: Is the second revision round accepted at no extra cost?
Are USD 400 and delivery on 20 November 2026 confirmed as agreed, never called proposed or not agreed?

orders.rule: 2 and 4 together: the agreed terms are confirmed, the client's new conflicting request is not accepted, no new price
orders.task_text: Marta, dueña de una tienda online de cerámica, ya acordó conmigo 8 fotos de producto editadas por 240 EUR, con entrega el 12 de diciembre de 2026. Ahora pide también 15 fotos más y entrega el 5 de diciembre, por el mismo precio. La sesión de fotos y la impresión no están incluidas. Escribe una respuesta que confirme lo acordado y que no acepte el nuevo pedido en esas condiciones, sin inventar un precio nuevo.
orders.freelancer_positioning: Edito fotos de producto para tiendas online con Lightroom y Photoshop. He trabajado con marcas pequeñas de artesanía. Necesito las fotos originales antes de empezar.

criteria.question: Are the agreed 8 edited photos for 240 EUR by 12 December 2026 confirmed, never called proposed or not agreed?
Is the new request (15 more photos and delivery on 5 December for the same price) refused in so many words, with no new price?
Is none of the new request (15 more photos, delivery on 5 December, the same price) stated as accepted or agreed?

orders.rule: 1 over 4: explicit acceptance of a change wins over the conflict with the earlier limit (code review #2 P2)
orders.task_text: We agreed a 5-page Webflow site for EUR 1,500 with one revision round. The client asks for a second revision round. I accept it instead of our previously agreed one-round limit; the price and the 5 pages stay as agreed.
orders.freelancer_positioning: I build Webflow marketing sites for small businesses.

criteria.question: Is the second revision round accepted in place of the one-round limit?
Do EUR 1,500 and the 5 pages stay as agreed, never called proposed or not agreed?

orders.rule: 1: a counteroffer the freelancer directs in the order is made with exactly that value; the client's value is declined (code reviews #1 and #2 P2)
orders.task_text: A client wants a fully custom 12-page Webflow site within 48 hours for EUR 300. Copy and images arrive next week. Decline the EUR 300 budget and the 48-hour deadline, and offer EUR 800 for a smaller 5-page first phase, built after the copy arrives.
orders.freelancer_positioning: I build Webflow marketing sites and can scope work after reviewing content. My past work includes small business sites, but I have no search-ranking case studies. I only commit to timelines once dependencies and review rounds are agreed.

criteria.question: Is the EUR 300 budget refused in so many words?
Is the 48-hour deadline refused in so many words?
Does the freelancer offer EUR 800 as their own price for a smaller 5-page first phase built after the copy arrives?
Is none of the client's EUR 300 budget or 48-hour deadline stated as accepted, agreed or as the freelancer's own?

orders.rule: 3: terms left for discussion stay open without a value of the freelancer's own
orders.task_text: A SaaS startup needs onboarding emails rewritten: a welcome email and a 4-email trial sequence. The number of additional emails and the fee will be agreed after a 30-minute discovery call. They would like the first drafts in early January 2027, but the date is not fixed yet. Analytics setup is excluded.
orders.freelancer_positioning: I write lifecycle and onboarding emails for B2B SaaS products. I have rewritten trial sequences for two startups. I agree the scope and fee only after a discovery call.

criteria.question: Are the fee and the number of additional emails left to be agreed after the discovery call, with no amount?
Is early January 2027 kept as the client's wish that is not fixed, not promised as a deadline?
Is analytics setup kept out of the work?

orders.rule: 5 and 4: a budget ceiling stays the client's (not accepted as the price, not declined); the conflicting deadline is not accepted
orders.task_text: Стартап просит дизайн 5 экранов мобильного приложения доставки за 2 рабочих дня. Описание API и тексты интерфейса будут только через неделю. Бюджет до 80 000 ₽, окончательная цена после оценки. Иконки берутся из готовой библиотеки, анимации не входят. Нужно ответить, что срок нереален, и предложить реальный порядок работы, не придумывая даты.
orders.freelancer_positioning: Проектирую интерфейсы мобильных приложений в Figma. Делаю макеты по готовым текстам и данным API. Сроки называю только после получения всех материалов.

criteria.question: Is the 80 000 ₽ ceiling stated as the client's budget that is not an agreed price, with the final price after the estimate?
Is the 2-working-day deadline refused in so many words?
Does the answer avoid naming any date or duration of its own?
Is none of the client's 80 000 ₽ ceiling or 2-working-day deadline stated as accepted, agreed or as the freelancer's own price or term?

orders.rule: 4: a conflicting budget and a guarantee are not accepted, no replacement value (the 5 daily posts are scope, not a term)
orders.task_text: Una academia de idiomas quiere gestionar Instagram durante 3 meses por 200 EUR en total, con 5 publicaciones diarias, y exige garantizar 10 000 seguidores nuevos. Todavía no tiene fotos ni un calendario de cursos. Escribe una propuesta que identifique los conflictos, rechace la garantía de seguidores y proponga hablar de un primer mes más reducido. No aceptes el presupuesto ni inventes otro.
orders.freelancer_positioning: Gestiono redes sociales para escuelas y negocios locales. Preparo calendarios de contenido y textos para publicaciones. No garantizo cifras de seguidores.

criteria.question: Is the 200 EUR total budget refused in so many words?
Is the guarantee of 10 000 new followers refused in so many words?
Is none of the client's 200 EUR total budget or the guarantee of 10 000 new followers stated as accepted, agreed or as the freelancer's own?

orders.rule: 3 and 5: the budget ceiling is the client's proposal and the fee stays open; the requested work is scope offered as the freelancer's work, never called proposed or not agreed
orders.task_text: Northlake Books needs a Shopify accessibility review, not a redesign. Audit 6 templates: home, collection, product, cart, search, contact. Deliver a prioritized issue spreadsheet with reproduction steps and a 45-minute handover. Check keyboard use, focus, labels and contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA. No certification or legal compliance guarantee. We can provide staging access on 8 October 2026; the report is needed by 16 October if access arrives on time. Theme edits, third-party checkout and app remediation are excluded. Budget ceiling USD 1,200; final fee must be agreed after inspecting the theme.
orders.freelancer_positioning: I am a frontend developer who has performed manual keyboard and screen-reader checks on two ecommerce projects. I use browser devtools and axe as aids, and document limitations clearly. I am not a certified accessibility auditor and have no Shopify Plus experience.

criteria.question: Is the USD 1,200 ceiling stated as the client's budget that is not an agreed fee?
Does the final fee stay to be agreed after inspecting the theme (the condition may be in another sentence)?
Are the requested templates, spreadsheet and 45-minute handover stated as the work, never called proposed or not agreed?
Are redesign, theme edits, third-party checkout, app remediation, certification and a legal compliance guarantee kept out of the work?
Is none of the client's USD 1,200 ceiling stated as an agreed fee or as the freelancer's own?
